author: DrCrown93
quote: I’m not impressed…. Here are my reasons. GTA v first missions were 1. Bank robbery in north Yankton 2. Steal cars for Simeon 3. Retrieve a motorcycle from a gang4. Get Michael’s car back 5. Rescue jimmy and get the yacht back and the GTA vi missions so far are 1. Fix the roof 2. Fix the railing 3. Fix the stairs 4. Fix the walls 5. Paint the room….. it took 15 hours to get anywhere outside of chores. Even then the freedom sandbox game that is GTA is no longer feels that way with this game. Sorry not sorry. people that glaze this are the reason why things are happening to games that gamers don’t want. Another note…. You have to have an active gta+ subscription just to have access to some future story content…….. on top of the premium edition you may have dished 100 bucks for….. just for story content guys… gta+ is supposed to be for online benefits. If this were any other company or game to do this they would be buried by now
